Current econometric methods examined and discussed. ( Lec. 3, Lab. 2/Online) Pre: STA409 or equivalent, or permission of instructor.

(Lec. 3) Pre: Graduate standing or permission of the instructor.

Evaluation of system performance, assessment of public and ecosystem health impacts and effects of climate change. Create a supportive school environment, promoting student success and well -being through collaborative engagement and a shared vision. (Lec. 3)

EDL 501 | Legal and Ethical Issues in Educational Leadership, Effective Fall 2025 (3 crs.) Examine the legal foundation of schools and educational policy, analyzing cases, statutes, and constitutional provisions.
Explore legal, ethical, and political issues, including due process, discipline, and rights of marginalized students. (Lec. 3) EDL 502 | Fiscal Management for Educational Leaders, Effective Fall 2025 (3 cr.) Analyze systems for financing U.S. public schools.

Prioritize legal matters, business ethics, diversity, and equity in budget allocations. (Lec. 3) EDL 503 | Operations & Management for Educational Leaders, Effective Fall 2025 (3 crs.) Integrate organizational theories and leadership models for school operations and management.

Emphasize decision-making to establish dynamic learning communities. (Lec. 3) EDL 504 | Program Evaluation for Educational Leaders, Effective Fall 2025 (3 crs.) Introduce program planning, evaluation, and data-driven decision making.

Enhance curricula and assessment programs.
Develop and assess educational programs, making informed decisions to continue, adjust, or discontinue based on evaluation evidence. (Lec. 3) EDL 505 | Supervision of Instruction, Effective Fall 2025 (3 crs.) Focus on the principal's role in enhancing classroom instruction through supervision, evaluation, and faculty development.
Explore supervisory strategies, equity, access, and engagement.
Cultivate high - performing schools with accountability, improvement, and collaboration. (Lec. 3) EDL 506 | Instructional and Curriculum Leadership, Effective Fall 2025 (3 crs.) Explore the principal's role as an instructional leader promoting collaborative culture and shared decision-making.

Explore recruiting, hiring, development, conflict resolution, change management, and organizational climate. (Lec. 3) EDL 508 | Leading School & District Improvement, Effective Fall 2025 (3 crs.) Analyze and implement strategies for equitable educational improvements.
Emphasize data-driven decision-making, change management, culturally responsive leadership, and developing comprehensive school improvement plans. Complete 200 hours under principal and university supervision. (Internship) EDL 511 | Internship/Seminar II, Effective Fall 2025 (3 crs.) Engage in practical field experiences in school administration, applying RISEL standards.
Participate in seminars, reflect on experiences, and construct a leadership portfolio.
Complete 200 hours under principal and university supervision. (Internship)

EDL 520 | School Plant Planning, Effective Fall 2025 (3 crs.) Prepare aspiring superintendents and central office leaders in developing school building specifications. Learn planning for new and remodeled buildings, assessing facility needs, soliciting support, site selection, design, and maintenance. (Lec. 3) EDL 521 | Supervision of Special Education Programs & Services, Effective Fall 2025 (3 crs.) Examine the multifaceted responsibilities of special education leadership at the district level.
